Windows x64 candidate built from v1.9.2 (commit in SOURCE.txt) with Visual Studio
18 2026, MSVC 19.51.36256.0, CMake 4.2.1, Release, using
scripts/native/build-whisper-windows.ps1.

BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
GGML_BACKEND_DL=OFF
GGML_NATIVE=OFF
GGML_SSE42=OFF
GGML_AVX=OFF
GGML_AVX2=OFF
GGML_BMI2=OFF
GGML_OPENMP=OFF
GGML_VULKAN=OFF
GGML_CUDA=OFF
GGML_METAL=OFF
WHISPER_BUILD_TESTS=OFF
WHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON
CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0091=NEW
CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=MultiThreaded

The complete generated CMakeCache.txt is included as build-config.txt in the
candidate artifact. dumpbin /DEPENDENTS reports only KERNEL32.dll and
ADVAPI32.dll. SHA256SUMS.windows-amd64-msvc-candidate records the resulting
local executable; it is not yet an approved complete release bundle.
